verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe a built-in Agent you can brainstorm with to write scripts, generate images, videos and storyboards, and refine edits over multiple rounds. That is first-party conversational operation of the product, and MCP/CLI also lets external agents drive Kling. The evidence is only marketing one-liners, though, so the depth and scope of natural-language control are unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of which product operations the Agent can perform from natural-language commands, explicit command/chat interface details, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards—then refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production.
MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
